mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing 72 degrees with overcast skies at the Verona Public Library and an air quality index of 53, which is in the moderate range.

The city recently unveiled a seven-foot-tall public art sculpture titled Tai Chi Animal Frolics at Century School Park. This piece was carved from a reclaimed ash tree by artists Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland and celebrates traditional Tai Chi movements.

There is plenty to do this week, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today and Hop Haus Trivia this evening. Tomorrow, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard or the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a report regarding noteworthy calls from August 24 to August 31, police responded to an incident on August 28 where a vehicle collided with a parked car on South Nine Mound Road.
Today's flavor of the day is Snickers Swirl. The store is currently closed, but it opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
